utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday the twenty-second. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Unlike the heating in the portakabin, which apparently only has tropical and off.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Luxury. Some of us have a draught with a desk in it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Speaking of luxuries, the charity bake sale on Friday — that's today, before anyone says they've forgotten. Purely cake chat, not an action.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: There's a birthday cake in the office as well. We've accidentally scheduled a cake clash.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Finally, a scheduling problem I'm qualified for.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the breakfast meeting. What's already finished?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I finished the repair on the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's the one that was on yesterday's list, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, same one. Closed, not another job for this morning.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the guard switch on two yesterday. That's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, historical update. Not carrying that forward.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Oh, and I already swapped the filter on the wrapper yesterday. Nearly forgot that one. Also done.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Good, those are completions then, not three fresh entries.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The other thing — I can't get to the AC1 until production gives us a window. Still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Understood. No window, no commitment to do that today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah. Can't maintain it by staring through the fence, much as we've tried.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: On the outfeed conveyor, I'll grease and check the bearings.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's you taking the bearings, Priya?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do that one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Tom, can you swap the filter on the compressor one? No rush on that; at half two.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: At half two, rather than get it finished before half two?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, at half two. No rush — it doesn't need pulling forward.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fine, I'll swap the filter on the compressor one at half two.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped a bit there. That's separate from the filter you said was done?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, separate. The guard switch on two was yesterday. The compressor one is the agreed job.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Marc, can you run the monthly fire alarm test next week?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test next week.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Next week, not a test happening this morning. Just making sure I heard that correctly.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Correct, next week.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: While we're on that side of things, I'll check the guarding on the CV01 by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Thanks, Fiona. The guarding on the CV01, by 11am, with you.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock again, then. Sorry, two people came through at once.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, the CV01 guarding. The interlock repair is already finished.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Tomasz, can you chase the purchase order for the water booster on the 3rd? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, did you say on the 3rd, not before?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: On the 3rd, yes. Normal priority, nothing expedited.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. I'll chase the purchase order for the water booster on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Right, that's a purchase order chase, not another order being raised. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Um, an observation before I forget: I saw the pressure on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, noted as an observation, not opening a job from that.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Similar sort of update from me. I saw the pressure on the forklifts dip for a few minutes; it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: So both recovered, neither being put forward as a new task here?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. Mine's just what I saw, not a request for work today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Different issue on the line 1 hydraulics, though. I'll investigate the pressure drop on the line 1 hydraulics by the 28th. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, Fiona, normal priority and by the 28th for that investigation.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, agreed. I'll take that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry — talking over you — that's separate from the Line 3 Screw and Barrel dip?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Completely separate. The line 1 hydraulics investigation is the action; the other was just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: We've still got the seals to replace on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve by end of day. That's holding production up so it needs doing first. I'm raising the gap, not taking it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right. Who can take replacing those seals? We need an owner, not just a red line on the list.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't take that one. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I can't commit to it either. Don't put my name against it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, nobody has accepted the Boiler Safety Relief Valve seals. Still needed by end of day, still holding production up and needing doing first. Unallocated, not agreed to someone by silence.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: There's another unallocated one: someone needs to go to Kestrel in Leeds to pick up the replacement parts for the palletizer by 11am. Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Anyone able to take that collection? By 11am, and yes, drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I can't do the run. I'm flagging it because it's parts, but I'm not volunteering.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, I can't take the collection either.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No taker, then. The Kestrel in Leeds collection stays unallocated.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Those two urgent gaps need to be obvious in the record. Hearing them mentioned isn't the same as somebody accepting them.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Absolutely. Both still unowned. And the AC1 is blocked, the completed jobs stay completed, and the two recovered pressure dips are observations.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: My accepted ones are the compressor one filter at half two, no rush, and the water booster purchase order chase on the 3rd, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And mine are the CV01 guarding by 11am, plus investigating the pressure drop on the line 1 hydraulics by the 28th, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Monthly fire alarm test next week is mine. Not today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I'll grease and check the bearings on the outfeed conveyor. Right, that's the agreed work and the gaps. Thanks, everyone.
